beforeAfterComparisons.baseline: Menu is closed; the top-left hamburger has no visible outline. Pale-green selection remains over the initial P7 plain text.
beforeAfterComparisons.candidate: Menu is closed and a distinct dark-green rectangular outline surrounds the top-left hamburger/menu button (approximately x10–43, y0–35). Initial text selection remains visible in the same place; document body layout is preserved.
beforeAfterComparisons.pixelConclusion: Visible keyboard focus indication has returned to the menu opener; baseline lacks that opener indication.

beforeAfterComparisons.baseline: Text caret remains in the first paragraph; the first line begins slightly indented. Footer shows an orange unsaved indicator and no outline around the sidebar button.
beforeAfterComparisons.candidate: A rounded dark-green outline surrounds the bottom-left sidebar button (approximately x10–38, y774–798). The paragraph starts at the regular left alignment and footer shows the saved state with a grey indicator.
beforeAfterComparisons.pixelConclusion: Visible focus leaves the text proxy for the sidebar control; the baseline visibly altered the editing state. Exact document equality is separate hash evidence.

beforeAfterComparisons.baseline: No top-left menu outline; a text caret remains at the start of the first line.
beforeAfterComparisons.candidate: Top-left menu button has the distinct rectangular dark-green focus outline; no editor-wide outline obscures the source.
beforeAfterComparisons.pixelConclusion: Reverse navigation visibly reaches the menu control instead of remaining at the text proxy.

beforeAfterComparisons.baseline: No extra outline around the checked task checkbox; a text caret remains at the beginning of the first paragraph.
beforeAfterComparisons.candidate: A clear rounded focus outline surrounds the checked checkbox for P7 checked task English (approximately x26–48, y309–331). Its checked state and text remain unchanged.
beforeAfterComparisons.pixelConclusion: Reverse navigation visibly reaches an interactive task control. This is inside rendered editor content, so it is not claimed to leave the entire editor container.

pixelFindings.eightFormerFailurePairs: All eight original before/after pairs were opened at native 1280x800 resolution. Visible focus indicators support the intended menu/Tab/Shift+Tab changes.
pixelFindings.layoutScope: Four contact sheets cover all 24 candidate sample panels. Detailed original-size inspection is limited to the eight targeted candidate states and their baseline counterparts.

separateNonPixelEvidence.note: These reported DOM/byte assertions are not substituted for pixel inspection. Screenshot text cannot prove exact Unicode codepoints or byte equality.

limitations: No screen reader, actual OS IME/candidate-window or other operating system was exercised by this review.
No color-contrast ratio was computed; the focus outlines are visibly distinguishable in these saved images.
Screenshots show end-state focus indication, not the complete event trajectory; native samples record that separately.
Only the listed 20 files were opened. Other original PNGs are not marked individually reviewed merely because they appear in a contact sheet.
No claim of comprehensive theme/zoom/DPI matrix review; that independent native matrix is still owned by catalog.
